lines.text: Many learners say: I am teacher.
A doctor! He is a doctor.

native.tip: Dalam bahasa Indonesia “Saya guru” tanpa kata sandang, tapi bahasa Inggris butuh a sebelum nama pekerjaan.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am teacher.” 😅 Sebelum pekerjaan, tambahkan a: “I am a teacher.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “a doctor”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang pekerjaanmu atau pekerjaan ayahmu dengan I am a atau He is a. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesian “Saya guru” has no extra word, but English needs a before a job.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am teacher.” 😅 Before a job, add a: “I am a teacher.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
